decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be commenced before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

<p><span style="font-size:11.0pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">Notwithstanding
the details submitted with the application, no development above ground floor
slab level shall take place until details of all facing materials and external
surfaces of the buildings hereby approved have been submitted to, and approved
in writing by, the Local Planning Authority. On-site samples shall be provided
for inspection by officers. The development shall be carried out in accordance
with the approved details.<o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal"><u>4. Construction Logistics Plan</u><o:p></o:p></p><p>

</p><p class="MsoNormal">Prior to commencement of the development, a CLP in line with
the TfL guidelines shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the
Council. The details shall include the numbers, size and routes of construction
vehicles, provisions within/around the site to ensure that all vehicles
associated with the construction works are properly managed to prevent any
unwanted disruption to other highway users, and other matters relating to
traffic management to be agreed with the licencing officers of the council. Approved
details shall be implemented throughout the project period and any changes to
the document must be reported back to the council’s planning and highways
department.&nbsp;&nbsp;<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal"><u>7. Cycle Storage</u><o:p></o:p></p><p>

</p><p class="MsoNormal">Notwithstanding the details submitted with the application,
prior to above ground works, full details of cycle parking facilities shall be
submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. This
shall demonstrate that the cycle parking is in compliance with Policy T5 of the
London Plan and meets the requirements of the London Cycling Design Standards
(LCDS). Prior to occupation, the approved details shall be fully implemented.
Thereafter, the cycle parking facilities shall be permanently retained.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal"><b><span style="font-size:11.0pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">Scheme
of Acoustic Protection<o:p></o:p></span></b></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">Prior to commencement of residential units,&nbsp;full details of a
scheme of acoustic protection of habitable rooms against noise shall be
submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.&nbsp; The
scheme of acoustic protection shall be sufficient to secure internal noise
levels no greater than:</span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left:14.2pt;text-indent:-14.2pt"><span style="font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">a.&nbsp; 35
dB LAeq in living rooms and bedrooms (07:00 hours to 23:00 hours) with windows
closed; and<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">b.&nbsp; 30 dB LAeq in bedrooms (23:00 hours to 07:00 hours) with
windows closed.</span><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">Additionally, where the internal noise levels will exceed 40 dB
LAeq in living rooms and bedrooms (07:00 hours to 23:00 hours) or 35dB LAeq in
bedrooms (23:00 hours to 07:00 hours) with windows open the scheme of acoustic
protection shall incorporate a ventilator system which is commensurate with</span><span style="font-size:11.0pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;color:red">&nbsp;</span><span style="font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">the
Acoustic Ventilation and Overheating Residential Design Guide January 2020. The
approved scheme shall be fully implemented before the first occupation of the
residential unit to which it relates and shall be always maintained thereafter.</span></p><p>















</p><p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">External space noise levels shall be assessed in accordance with
BS8233.<o:p></o:p></span></p>
